data.name: ClearFilter
data.comment: aria-label for the button that clears the toolbar filter text.

data.name: ItemsSelected
data.comment: Toolbar text showing how many rows are selected. {0} is the count.

data.name: Clear
data.comment: Text on the button that clears the current selection.

data.name: Show
data.comment: Label before the page-size selector.

data.name: ItemsPerPage
data.comment: aria-label for the page-size dropdown.

data.name: LoadingData
data.comment: aria-label on the skeleton loading block.

data.name: Loading
data.comment: aria-label on the spinner loading block.

data.name: NoDataAvailable
data.comment: Text shown when the data collection has no items.

data.name: SearchPlaceholder
data.comment: Placeholder text for the filter search box.

data.name: ExpandRow
data.comment: aria-label for the expand-toggle header cell in a grid.

data.name: DeselectAll
data.comment: aria-label for the select-all button when everything is selected.

data.name: SelectAll
data.comment: aria-label for the select-all button when nothing is selected.

data.name: SortColumn
data.comment: Title on the sort button inside a column header.

data.name: SortPriority
data.comment: Title/aria-label showing the multi-column sort priority. {0} is the 1-based priority number.

data.name: ResizeColumn
data.comment: aria-label on the column resize handle. {0} is the column header text.

data.name: RowActions
data.comment: aria-label on the actions column header.

data.name: CollapseRow
data.comment: aria-label on the toggle button when a row detail is expanded (grid).

data.name: SortByColumn
data.comment: aria-label on the sort dropdown in data-cards.

data.name: SortBy
data.comment: Label before the sort dropdown in data-cards.

data.name: None
data.comment: Default option in the sort-by dropdown (no sorting).

data.name: ToggleSortDirection
data.comment: aria-label on the button that flips ascending/descending in data-cards.

data.name: AggregateTotals
data.comment: aria-label on the summary band in data-cards.

data.name: CollapseDetails
data.comment: aria-label on the detail toggle when expanded (cards).

data.name: ExpandDetails
data.comment: aria-label on the detail toggle when collapsed (cards).

data.name: Details
data.comment: aria-label on the detail section in data-cards.

data.name: NoDataAvailableLive
data.comment: Screen-reader live-region message when the collection is empty.

data.name: SortedBy
data.comment: Live-region message when data is sorted. {0} is the column name, {1} is the direction (ascending/descending).

data.name: Row
data.comment: Singular form of "row" used in live-region messages.

data.name: Rows
data.comment: Plural form of "row" used in live-region messages.

data.name: RowsVisibleOfTotal
data.comment: Live-region message when a filter is active. {0}=filtered count, {1}=row/rows, {2}=total count.

data.name: PageXOfY
data.comment: Live-region message for pagination. {0}=current page, {1}=total pages.

data.name: Ascending
data.comment: Sort direction used in live-region messages.

data.name: Descending
data.comment: Sort direction used in live-region messages.

data.name: AggregateCount
data.comment: Lower-case label for the Count aggregate function used in aria-labels.

data.name: AggregateSum
data.comment: Lower-case label for the Sum aggregate function used in aria-labels.

data.name: AggregateAverage
data.comment: Lower-case label for the Average aggregate function used in aria-labels.

data.name: AggregateMin
data.comment: Lower-case label for the Min aggregate function used in aria-labels.

data.name: AggregateMax
data.comment: Lower-case label for the Max aggregate function used in aria-labels.
